```artifact
Feature: Services within Padmavathi Hospital Zone

  Scenario: Patients register for appointments within the specified zone
  Given the hospital is within a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi or specified PinCodes
  When a patient resides in the zone
  Then they should be able to register for appointments

  Scenario Outline: Patient registration for appointments
  Examples:
    | Patient Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Inside Zone      | 12345  | Success         |
    | Inside Zone      | 67890  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone     | 12345  | Failure         |
    | Outside Zone     | 67890  | Failure         |

  Scenario: Chemist operations within the specified zone
  Given there is one authorized chemist per PinCode
  When a chemist operates in the zone
  Then they should provide services

  Scenario Outline: Chemist operations
  Examples:
    | Chemist Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Inside Zone      | 12345  | Success         |
    | Inside Zone      | 67890  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone     | 12345  | Failure         |
    | Outside Zone     | 67890  | Failure         |

  Scenario: Prescription delivery and collection
  Given a prescription is matched to a chemist
  When a chemist delivers medicines
  Then they should collect payment

  Scenario Outline: Prescription delivery and collection
  Examples:
    | Chemist Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Inside Zone      | 12345  | Success         |
    | Inside Zone      | 67890  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone     | 12345  | Failure         |
    | Outside Zone     | 67890  | Failure         |

  Scenario: Laboratory operations within the specified zone
  Given there is one laboratory per PinCode or for the entire zone
  When a laboratory operates in the zone
  Then they should provide services

  Scenario Outline: Laboratory operations
  Examples:
    | Laboratory Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Inside Zone      | 12345  | Success         |
    | Inside Zone      | 67890  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone     | 12345  | Failure         |
    | Outside Zone     | 67890  | Failure         |

  Scenario: No systemic matching for chemist efficiency
  Given no systemic matching is performed
  When the system operates
  Then no efficiency matching should occur

  Scenario Outline: No systemic matching
  Examples:
    | Chemist Location | PinCode | Expected Result |
    | Inside Zone      | 12345  | Success         |
    | Inside Zone      | 67890  | Success         |
    | Outside Zone     | 12345  | Failure         |
    | Outside Zone     | 67890  | Failure         |
